panels.title: VMs down
panels.description: Seen in the last 6h but not answering now. On-demand VMs count while asleep.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (RequestPath) (count_over_time({job="traefik-access", host="vm-200"} | json DownstreamStatus, RequestPath | __error__="" | DownstreamStatus >= 400 [$__range])))
topk(10, sum by (user) (count_over_time({host="vm-101", unit="authelia-main.service"} |= "Successful" | regexp "by user '(?P<user>[^']+)'" [$__range])))
